Sabar kamyabi ki maa hai.
Khali bartan sabse zyada shor karte hain.
Jo lagta hai na ho sake, wahi karo.
Courage sabhi gunon mein sabse zaroori hai.
Chup raho, strong bano.
Grit hai, zindagi ko matters samajh ke jeena.
Jab aapne saari sambhavnaayein aazma li ho, toh yaad rakhein: abhi bhi kuch baaki hai.
Resilience milti nahi, earn hoti hai.
Khamoshi shaktishali gyaan hai.
Khamoshi anant jitni gehri hai.
Khamoshi sikhati; shor bhatkata.
Himmat duniya badalti hai.
Bahadur insaan kabhi akela nahi hota.
Himmat unchi hai.
Khamoshi ek shield ban sakti hai.
Sirf bolo agar khamoshi behtar ho jaye.
Grit woh hai jo jaane se aasaan hone par bhi ruk jaye.
Grit discipline hai jo persistence pehenti.
Taqat ko himmat chahiye.
Grit matlab apna waada nibhana.
